english.note: Use 大龍鳳 when someone turns a simple matter into an elaborate fuss or spectacle.
Use this for a noisy or elaborate spectacle or fuss rather than a literal circus.

examples.english: You don't need to make such a production out of setting a table.
examples.traditional: 你唔使為咗擺張枱搞咁大龍鳳。
examples.jyutping: nei5 m4 sai2 wai6 zo2 baai2 zoeng1 toi2 gaau2 gam3 daai6 lung4 fung6

examples.english: You don’t need to make such a circus out of it.
examples.jyutping: nei5 dei6 m4 sai2 gaau2 gam3 daai6 lung4 fung6
